verdict.rationale: Expensify markets 'Ask Expensify AI' for creating/categorizing/tagging expenses via plain language (expensify-docs-3, expensify-docs-4) and SmartScan for automated receipt reading (expensify-docs-6), but independent hands-on reports concretely contradict the AI-quality claims: categorization is wrong ~70% of the time (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4) and SmartScan historically relied on human Mechanical Turk workers rather than pure AI, raising both accuracy and privacy issues (expensify-comm-2, expensify-comm-3). No evidence at all addresses duplicate or fraud detection. Missing for 10: verified fraud/duplicate detection capability, independent confirmation that categorization/memo suggestions are accurate and AI-driven rather than human-assisted, and resolution of the contradicting community accuracy reports.
